finding: Maternal cardiometabolic risk factors (hyperglycemia, pre-existing hypertension, and overweight/obesity) were independently associated with an increased risk of primary cesarean delivery, even among women delivering infants born at an appropriate size for gestational age.
mod_finding: Maternal cardiometabolic risk factors, including overweight/obesity, hyperglycemia, and pre-existing hypertension, were independently associated with an increased risk of primary cesarean delivery.
